'''Tevlun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Tevlun raised a family on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]] and to financially support them, he began working for the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guild]] as a bonded [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] on the planet [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. Tevlun would operate a [[laser transport array]] to allow people to land on the world and for his fourth such landing on Nyriaan, Tevlun was tasked with landing a group of Republic agents, and he rendezvoused with them at [[Platform Trill 92]], in orbit of Nyriaan. However, while he was landing the agents' [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the laser that was guiding the ship was deactivated.

==Skills and abilities==
Tevlun was fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Nyriaanan (language)|Nyriaan]], and [[Snivvian (language)|Snivvian]].<ref name="GoI" />
